items.headline: Week 3 NFL highlights: Best plays, moments, touchdowns, more
items.description: Sunday of Week 3 will feature 14 games, including an international game in Rio de Janeiro between the Ravens and Cowboys.

items.headline: NFL Week 3's best arrivals, led by Lamar Jackson in Rio
items.description: NFL stars continue to turn game-day arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.

items.headline: Ravens WR Zay Flowers to play after positive Rio workout
items.description: Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers will play against the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro after having an encouraging workout before the game.

items.headline: Rio field gets final touches, 'no need to worry' NFL says
items.description: NFL field director Nick Pappas said Saturday that the league has made additional improvements to the Rio field and that "things check out" ahead of Sunday's game between the Ravens and Cowboys.

items.headline: NFL Week 3 predictions: Upsets, fantasy sleepers, stat lines
items.description: Touchdowns for Kenneth Walker III and Xavier Worthy? The Broncos pulling an upset of the Rams? Fantasy value for C.J. Stroud? And a big day from Geno Smith?
items.byline: Matt Bowen, Pamela Maldonado, Eric Moody, Ben Solak and Seth Walder

items.headline: NFL, NFLPA continue to monitor field conditions in Rio
items.description: Field experts for the NFL and the NFL Players Association have been in Brazil for days to monitor the playing surface at Maracanã Stadium, NFLPA executive director JC Tretter said in a lengthy statement on Friday.
